summary: Siliguri to Lataguri, the gateway to Gorumara, is about 80 km and takes 2–2.5 hours by car through Sevoke, Odlabari and Malbazar. A reserved car is easiest; a bus to Malbazar and a local auto is cheapest.

options.fare: ₹100–180 a seat plus ₹150–300 for the auto
options.text: North Bengal State Transport and private buses for Malbazar, Alipurduar and Coochbehar leave the Tenzing Norgay bus terminus on Hill Cart Road often through the day. Get off at Malbazar and take a shared or reserved auto or toto the last 10 km to Lataguri. Some Mainaguri and Jalpaiguri buses via Lataguri also run; ask at the stand.

Hire a car from Siliguri, NJP or Bagdogra. The route crosses the Teesta at the Coronation Bridge near Sevoke, then follows the foothills through Odlabari and Malbazar. Fix the rate first and confirm tolls and parking are included.
Trains on the Dooars line from Siliguri Junction or NJP stop at New Mal Junction, about 10 km from Lataguri. Services are few, so check timings. Take an auto or toto from the station.

stops_on_way: Coronation Bridge over the Teesta at Sevoke
Tea gardens around Odlabari and Damdim
tip: Elephants cross the road between Malbazar and Lataguri around dusk, so aim to arrive in daylight.

faqs.q: How far is Gorumara from Siliguri?
faqs.a: Lataguri, where most Gorumara lodges and the main safari counter are, is about 80 km from Siliguri. The drive takes 2–2.5 hours via Sevoke, the Coronation Bridge, Odlabari and Malbazar. From Bagdogra airport add about 30 minutes, and from NJP about 15 minutes.

faqs.q: What does a car from Siliguri to Lataguri cost?
faqs.a: A reserved hatchback or sedan costs roughly ₹2,800–3,500 one way, and an SUV ₹3,300–3,800. Prices rise during the Puja holidays and at New Year. For a round trip with sightseeing, drivers usually charge ₹3,500–4,500 a day. Fares are indicative.

faqs.q: Is there a direct bus from Siliguri to Lataguri?
faqs.a: A few buses for Mainaguri and Jalpaiguri via Lataguri run from Siliguri, but the reliable option is any bus to Malbazar, which leave often from the Tenzing Norgay bus terminus. From Malbazar it is about 10 km to Lataguri by auto or toto. Buses are cheap and crowded at peak times.

faqs.q: Which railway station is nearest to Gorumara?
faqs.a: New Mal Junction, on the Dooars line, is about 10 km from Lataguri. Chalsa station is useful for Chalsa resorts and Samsing. Few trains run on this line, so check timings. For most travellers NJP is the practical railhead, followed by a car or bus.

summary: Siliguri to Madarihat, the entry to Jaldapara National Park, is about 125 km and 3–3.5 hours by car along the Dooars road. Buses for Jaigaon and Alipurduar pass through Madarihat and are the cheapest option.

options.text: North Bengal State Transport and private buses for Jaigaon, Hasimara and Alipurduar leave the Tenzing Norgay bus terminus through the day. Ask for one that runs via Birpara and Madarihat, and get off at Madarihat, close to the Jaldapara Tourist Lodge.
Hire a car from Siliguri, NJP or Bagdogra. The road runs via Sevoke, Malbazar, Chalsa, Nagrakata and Birpara. Break the trip at Gorumara if you have time.

Trains on the Dooars line from Siliguri Junction or NJP towards Alipurduar stop at Madarihat and Hasimara. Madarihat station is within walking distance of the tourist lodge. Check current timings; services are limited.

stops_on_way: Chalsa hilltop view over the Dooars
Tea estates around Nagrakata and Banarhat
tip: Leave Siliguri by 9 am so you reach Madarihat in time for an afternoon safari slot.

faqs.q: How far is Jaldapara from Siliguri?
faqs.a: Madarihat, the entry town for Jaldapara National Park, is about 125 km from Siliguri. A car takes 3–3.5 hours along the Dooars road through Malbazar, Chalsa and Birpara. Buses take 4–4.5 hours with stops. From Bagdogra airport allow an extra 30 minutes.

faqs.q: How much is a car from Siliguri to Jaldapara?
faqs.a: A reserved sedan or hatchback costs roughly ₹3,800–4,500 one way and an SUV ₹4,500–5,000. If you combine Gorumara and Jaldapara with a driver for three or four days, expect ₹3,500–4,500 a day plus the driver's food and stay. Rates are indicative.

faqs.q: Can I go from Siliguri to Jaldapara by train?
faqs.a: Yes. Trains on the Dooars line between Siliguri Junction or NJP and Alipurduar stop at Madarihat and Hasimara. Madarihat station is close to the Jaldapara Tourist Lodge. There are only a few services a day, so plan around them and book ahead for longer-distance trains.

faqs.q: Which is nearer to Jaldapara, Madarihat or Hasimara?
faqs.a: Madarihat is the main entry point, with the tourist lodge, safari counter and park gate. Hasimara is about 20 km further east, closer to Chilapata, Jaigaon and the Bhutan border at Phuentsholing. Stay at Madarihat for Jaldapara safaris and at Hasimara or Chilapata for the eastern forests.

summary: Lataguri to Madarihat is about 75 km and 2 hours by car, linking the two main Dooars parks. Most travellers do it by reserved car between a morning safari and an afternoon one.

options.text: Drive back towards Chalsa, then east through Nagrakata, Banarhat and Birpara to Madarihat. If you already have a car and driver from Siliguri, this is part of the day's run.
Take an auto from Lataguri to Malbazar or Chalsa and catch a bus heading for Birpara, Hasimara, Jaigaon or Alipurduar. Ask to be let off at Madarihat.

tip: Take the dawn safari at Gorumara, check out by 10 am and you can reach Madarihat for lunch and an afternoon slot.

faqs.q: How long is the drive from Gorumara to Jaldapara?
faqs.a: About 75 km and 2 hours by car from Lataguri to Madarihat via Chalsa, Nagrakata and Birpara. Add 30 minutes if you are staying at Murti or Chalsa rather than Lataguri. The road is mostly good two-lane highway through tea estates and small towns.

faqs.q: Can I visit both Gorumara and Jaldapara in one day?
faqs.a: It is possible to do a dawn safari at Gorumara and an afternoon safari at Jaldapara on the same day, if you have confirmed slots for both. It is a tiring day. A night in each place, with two safaris in each, gives much better chances of seeing rhino and elephants.

faqs.q: Is there a bus from Lataguri to Madarihat?
faqs.a: No direct bus is reliable. Take an auto or toto from Lataguri to Malbazar or Chalsa, then a bus to Birpara, Hasimara, Jaigaon or Alipurduar that passes Madarihat. Allow 3–3.5 hours in all. Buses are cheap but crowded on market days.

faqs.q: Is it safe to drive this road at night?
faqs.a: Avoid it after dark. Elephant herds cross the highway in several places between Chalsa and Birpara, and the forest department sometimes stops traffic. Night driving also means missing the tea garden views. Plan to arrive before sunset.

summary: Madarihat to Rajabhatkhawa, the gateway to Buxa Tiger Reserve, is about 55 km and 1.5 hours by car via Hasimara and Kalchini. Santalabari, where the Buxa Fort walk starts, is about 15 km further.

options.text: Drive east via Hasimara and Kalchini to Rajabhatkhawa, where you pay the reserve entry fee, then on through the forest to Santalabari for Buxa Fort or to Jayanti. A car is the practical choice for this leg.
Take a bus to Alipurduar or Hasimara, then a local bus or shared jeep to Rajabhatkhawa. From there shared and reserved jeeps run to Santalabari and Jayanti, but timings are irregular. Start early.

tip: Reach Santalabari by noon if you plan to walk up to Buxa Fort the same day.

faqs.q: How far is Buxa Fort from Jaldapara?
faqs.a: From Madarihat it is about 55 km to Rajabhatkhawa and another 15 km to Santalabari, roughly 2–2.5 hours by car. From Santalabari the walk up to Buxa Fort is about 4–5 km and takes 1.5–2 hours. Add Chilapata on the way if you start early.

faqs.q: Is there an entry fee for Buxa Tiger Reserve?
faqs.a: Yes. Vehicles and visitors pay entry fees at the Rajabhatkhawa gate, and a guide fee is charged for the Buxa Fort walk at Santalabari. Fees are modest but change from season to season. Carry photo ID and cash. Check current status before you travel.

faqs.q: Can I reach Buxa from Alipurduar?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is closer. Rajabhatkhawa is about 17 km from Alipurduar town, and Alipurduar Junction is the nearest major railway station. Cars and local jeeps run from Alipurduar to Rajabhatkhawa, Santalabari and Jayanti.

faqs.q: Is the Buxa road open in the monsoon?
faqs.a: The core area of Buxa Tiger Reserve closes for tourism from 16 June to 15 September, and riverbed crossings towards Jayanti can flood. Outside those dates the road is generally open. After heavy rain, ask in Alipurduar or Rajabhatkhawa before you set out.
